rationale: Candidate accurately maps all markdown content into coherent sections. Structure is solid but omits source metadata fields (source_uri, source_author, source_published, tags, etc.) present in the reference, and uses null timestamps. Faithfulness is perfect: every string is directly supported by the markdown; no invented claims. Coverage includes all topics, key points, frameworks, examples, takeaways, quotes, and claims. Precision is high; quotes verbatim (e.g., 'Jinja is awful.'), names and numbers exact. Compression is reduced because content is repeated across topic_map, key_points, examples, and quotes, mirroring markdown redundancy rather than condensing.
